# identitynow_connector_rules_v1 (Data Source)

Lists all [Connector Rules](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/extensibility/rules/) from IdentityNow/ISC via `GET /connector-rules/v1`. Returns the same attributes per rule as the singular `identitynow_connector_rule_v1` data source.

~> This is a `_v1` pilot data source - see `identitynow_connector_rule_v1`'s "Known Limitations & Live Testing Notes" section before relying on it in production configurations; the same limitations apply to each rule returned here. Note this endpoint has no filtering/pagination support in the current SDK - every connector rule in the tenant is always returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lists every connector rule in the tenant - this endpoint has no
# filtering/pagination support, so "connector_rules" always contains all of
# them. Each entry has the same attributes as identitynow_connector_rule_v1.
data "identitynow_connector_rules_v1" "example" {}

output "connector_rule_ids" {
  value = [for r in data.identitynow_connector_rules_v1.example.connector_rules : r.id]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `connector_rules` (Attributes List) All Connector Rules in the tenant, each with the same attributes as `identitynow_connector_rule_v1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_rules))

<a id="nestedatt--connector_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connector_rules`

Read-Only:

- `attributes` (String) A raw JSON object of arbitrary metadata about the connector rule. Unlike identitynow_transform_v1's "attributes" (a discriminated union keyed by "type"), this has no fixed shape.
- `created` (String) an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this rule was created
- `description` (String) a description of the rule's purpose
- `id` (String) the ID of the rule
- `modified` (String) an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this rule was last modified
- `name` (String) the name of the rule
- `signature` (Attributes) The rule's function signature. Describes the rule's input arguments and output (if any) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_rules--signature))
- `source_code` (Attributes) SourceCode (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_rules--source_code))
- `type` (String) the type of rule

<a id="nestedatt--connector_rules--signature"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connector_rules.signature`

Read-Only:

- `input` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_rules--signature--input))
- `output` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_rules--signature--output))

<a id="nestedatt--connector_rules--signature--input"></a>
